novel_features.name: Bulk host outreach
novel_features.description: Search a location and message the top hosts with a templated message in one command.
novel_features.rationale: Only possible because search results and the messaging API live behind one authenticated client — the website makes you open each listing and type each message by hand.
novel_features.example: airbnb-pp-cli outreach run "Berlin, Germany" --message "Hi {name} team, interested in a monthly stay — possible?" --limit 5
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when a user wants to contact many property owners at once (relocation, long-stay, business inquiry).

novel_features.name: Outreach CRM
novel_features.description: Local record of every host you contacted, when, and about which listing.
novel_features.rationale: Requires persisting each contact locally — the website has no outreach history view.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use after an outreach run to track who was contacted before following up.

novel_features.name: Offline conversation archive
novel_features.description: Full-text search across every message thread you've synced, offline.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a local SQLite FTS index of your threads and messages — Airbnb has no cross-conversation search.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to find what a host promised across months of conversations without scrolling the web inbox.

novel_features.name: Listing price watch
novel_features.description: Track saved listings' prices over time and report drops.
novel_features.rationale: Requires local price snapshots over time — the website shows only the current price, no history.
novel_features.example: airbnb-pp-cli watch add 49070135 --checkin 2026-08-10 --checkout 2026-08-14 && airbnb-pp-cli watch check
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to catch a price drop on a listing a user is considering.

novel_features.name: Self-healing operation registry
novel_features.description: Re-harvest Airbnb's current GraphQL persisted-query hashes from its own JS so the CLI survives Airbnb deploys.
novel_features.rationale: Airbnb rotates persisted-query hashes on deploy; harvesting them at runtime is only possible because we parse the live web bundles.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run this if commands start failing after an Airbnb update, before assuming the CLI is broken.

narrative.headline: Script Airbnb's real logged-in surface — search stays, contact hosts with templated messages and photos, and keep an offline archive of every conversation.
narrative.value_prop: Airbnb has no public API, so this CLI drives its internal GraphQL surface directly: it authenticates by importing your logged-in Chrome session (no password), searches stays, reads and sends messages, and adds bulk host outreach, a local CRM, offline conversation search, and price watching that the website has no equivalent for.
narrative.auth_narrative: No password is handled. Run 'auth login --chrome' to import your Airbnb session cookies from Chrome (close Chrome first, or paste a Cookie header with 'auth login --cookies'). Public search works with no login; private data (inbox, messages, trips, wishlists) needs the session.

quickstart.comment: import your logged-in Airbnb session from Chrome

quickstart.command: airbnb-pp-cli outreach run "Berlin, Germany" --message "Hi {name}, interested in a long stay" --limit 5
quickstart.comment: preview a bulk outreach (add --confirm to send)

troubleshoots.fix: Close Chrome (it locks the cookie DB), then re-run; or use 'auth login --cookies "<header>"'.
Open airbnb.com in a browser, pass the human check, then run 'auth login --chrome' again.

troubleshoots.symptom: 'unknown operation' or a command suddenly fails
troubleshoots.fix: Run 'airbnb-pp-cli ops refresh' to re-harvest Airbnb's current operation hashes.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to automate Airbnb tasks that the website forces you to do by hand: searching many stays, contacting property owners at scale, keeping a searchable archive of host conversations, or watching listing prices. It is the right tool when a user is doing outreach to hosts/owners or wants their Airbnb data locally and scriptable.

recipes.title: Search and narrow with --select
recipes.explanation: Search returns large nested payloads; --agent with --select keeps only the fields you need.

recipes.title: Contact one host (guarded)
recipes.command: airbnb-pp-cli contact 49070135 --message "Hi, is a monthly stay possible?" --confirm
recipes.explanation: Opens a conversation with a listing's host; without --confirm it only previews.

recipes.title: Archive then search conversations
recipes.command: airbnb-pp-cli archive index && airbnb-pp-cli archive search "deposit"
recipes.explanation: Pull your inbox into local SQLite, then full-text search it offline.

recipes.title: Watch a listing's price
recipes.command: airbnb-pp-cli watch add 49070135 --checkin 2026-08-10 --checkout 2026-08-14 && airbnb-pp-cli watch check --json
recipes.explanation: Snapshot a listing's price and detect changes on later checks.
